13098.name: Entity - is Sitting (Property)
13098.desc:
Returns whether an entity is sat. Can be set.
This works for Cats, Wolves, Parrots, Pandas and Foxes.
On Paper 1.20.1+ it applies for some other entities which have a SITTING pose.

1579.name: Vector Path
1579.desc: Creates a path between vectors. The density value controls the amount of points. A higher number increases the amount of points. A density of 1 corresponds to 1 point per block.

11563.name: Tree of List Variable
11563.desc: Returns all indices of a list variable. In vanilla Skript, if you set "{_var::a::b}" and loop {_var::*} nothing would be looped but this expression recursively gets all indices.

12331.name: Entity - Should Burn In Day
12331.desc:
Checks if an Entity should burn in daylight.
(Zombie,Phantom,Skeleton)

For skeletons, this does not take into account the entity's natural fire immunity.

Gets the provided entities or entity snapshots as their NBT string.

Returns whether or not the provided entities should burn during the day.

Can be set.

Set the request header properties.

12077.name: Region - Hollow Out
12077.desc:
Hollows out objects in a given region, using a given thickness and leaving behind a given pattern.
The default thickness is 1, and the default pattern is just air.

12333.name: Entity - is Converting
12333.desc:
Checks if an entity is being converted.

13101.name: Fluid Level Change Event - new Block Data

13613.name: Entity - is Angry (Property)
13613.desc:
Returns the Angry Property of an entity. (Warden, PigZombie, Wolf, Enderman)
Can be set for all except wardens.

6958.name: On Thread Join Event
6958.desc: Fired when a member joins a tread, either by joining itself or by a moderator can be used to get the thread, the guild and the member.

8238.name: Set response header
8238.desc:
This is an effect that can be used within a web request event.
You can edit the response header. Header key is case sensitive.

12078.name: Region - Move
12078.desc:
Moves the blocks in a given region in a given direction a given distance.
You can choose to only move the blocks that match a given mask too, as well as filling the left-behind area using a certain pattern.
Additionally, air can be ignored, and entities and biomes can be copied.

By default, the distance will be 1, all blocks will be moved, no pattern will be left behind, air will not be ignored, and entities and biomes will not be copied.
12078.pattern: move [(blocks that match|all) %-string/itemtype/worldeditmask% in] %worldeditregions% (up|down|north|south|east|west) [%-number% (time|block)[s]] [and (fill the area with|leave behind) [pattern] %-string/itemtype/worldeditpattern%] [while ignoring air[,]] [while copying entities[,| and]] [while copying biomes] [lazily]

13614.name: Entity - is Interested (Property)
13614.desc:
Returns whether or not the provided foxes or wolves are interested.
Paper 1.18.2+ is required to use this with foxes.
13614.pattern:
[the] [[living[ |-]]entity] [is] interested [state|property] of %livingentities%

whether [the] [[living[ |-]]entity] %livingentities% [is] interested [or not]

6959.name: On Thread Leave Event
6959.desc: Fired when a member leaves a thread, either by leaving itself or by a moderator can be used to get the thread, the guild and the member.

8239.name: Start HTTP server
8239.desc:
This effect is used to start the HTTP server.
If you don't specified the port number it uses config value (default 8080)

12079.name: Region - Naturalize
12079.desc: Naturalizes a given region. This just changes the top 3 layers of blocks into grass/dirt, and the bottom layers into stone.

13615.name: Entity - is Sitting (Property)
13615.desc:
Returns whether an entity is sat. Can be set.
This works for Cats, Wolves, Parrots, Pandas and Foxes.
On Paper 1.20.1+ it applies for some other entities which have a SITTING pose.

6960.name: On User Activity Order Event
6960.desc: Fired when a user in a guild changes its activity. Ex: by playing something different can be used to get the old/new activities.

13616.name: Sign - is Editable (Property)
13616.desc:
Returns whether or not the provided signs are editable.
Can be set and reset (which makes it editable).
13616.pattern:
[the] [sign] [is] editable [state|property] of %blocks/blockstates/itemtypes%
%blocks/blockstates/itemtypes%'[s] [sign] [is] editable [state|property]
whether or not [the] [sign] %blocks/blockstates/itemtypes% [is] editable
whether [the] [sign] %blocks/blockstates/itemtypes% [is] editable [or not]

10289.name: Citizen Despawn/Respawn
10289.desc:
Despawning a citizen will remove it from the world, but won't deregister it.
Respawning a citizen will spawn it back into the world.

12081.name: Region - Regenerate
12081.desc:
Regenerates the area within a given region while optionally regenerating biomes, using a given seed.
The default seed is just the seed of the region's world, and biomes will not be regenerated by default.

12593.name: Is Hand
12593.desc: Checks what hand the player interacted with a block/furniture is. Does not work on any other events other then Interaction events.

13617.name: Spawner/Trial Spawner - Entity Type
13617.desc:
Gets the spawner entity type of the provided spawners or trial spawners (1.21+).

**Works with Items.**
**Works with Spawner Minecarts (Requires 1.20+).**

Can be set, reset (sets it to pig), and deleted (requires Minecraft 1.20+).

11570.name: Switch Case
11570.desc: The switch case executes one statement from multiple ones. Thus, it is like an if-else-if ladder statement. The switch statement is used to test the equality of a variable against several values specified in the tests cases.

12082.name: Region - Smooth
12082.desc:
Smooths the area within a given region a certain number of times. The default number of times is 1.
You can choose to only smooth blocks that match a certain mask.

7475.name: Slash Command Argument
7475.desc:
Represents a slash command argument.
The name is the ID used when defining the slash command.
Specify the type, so that Skript can parse it correctly. (if it's a number, operation wil be allowed for example)
The type should be the same used when defining the argument in the command.
7475.pattern:
[the] arg[ument] [(named|with name)] %string% as %optiontype%
[the] arg[ument] [(named|with name)] %string% as %optiontype%

12083.name: Create Spline
12083.desc:
Create a spline using a set of locations. The order of the locations in this effect matter.
A rigid spline will create straight lines from location to location, whereas a non-rigid spline will create a curved line which goes through all the locations.

13108.name: Item Frame - Item (Silently Set)
13108.desc:
Gets a copy of the item in the provided item frames.
Can be set and deleted, this expression supports the Silent Section, see examples.

13364.name: Hitbox With
13364.desc:
A Citizen Hitbox with the given components.
Scale is a multiplier for the hitbox. For example, if the width was 1 and the height was 2, then if the scale was 2, the hitbox's effective dimenstions would be 2 width and 4 height.
Default values are:
- Scale: 1
- Width: 1
- Height: 2
13364.pattern: [a] hitbox [with scale %number%[,| and]] [[with] width %number%[,| and]] [[with] height %number%]

3381.name: Set Translated Lore Line
3381.desc:
Sets a specific lore line of an item's lore to a translated value. (1.15+ only)

You can use the special pattern: "translation.key.here[inputs='hello','input 2','input Â§c3']" for complex translations.
3381.pattern:
set line %number% of %itemtype%'[s] lore to translated %string%
set line %number% of [the] lore of %itemtype% to translated %string%

6709.name: Create Bossbar
6709.desc: Creates a new Bossbar! (you should set a variable to the bossbar e.g. `set {bossbar} to new bossbar` so you can edit its properties and add players to it)

12085.name: Shape - Cylinder
12085.desc:
Creates a cylinder using a given pattern at a certain location.
You can choose for the cylinder to be hollow, and it can take a set of radii and a height.
By default, the radius is 5, the height is 1, and the cylinder will not be hollow.
12085.pattern: create [a] [hollow] cylinder ([made] out of|with|using) [pattern] %string/itemtype/worldeditpattern% [with radi(us|i) %-numbers%][,| and] [with height %-number%] at %locations% [lazily]

13109.name: Item Frame - Item Drop Chance
13109.desc:
The chance of the item being dropped upon this item frame's destruction.
Can be set, removed from, added to, reset (1) and deleted (0).

The final value is always clamped between 0 and 1.

1 = always drops; 0 = never drops.
13109.pattern:
[the] item[ |-]frame [item] drop chance of %entities%
%entities%'[s] item[ |-]frame [item] drop chance

13365.name: Last Created Citizen
13365.desc: The last created citizen.Only applicable if the citizen is created via this addon. Will not save when server restarts.

3382.name: Converted Key
3382.desc: Generates a translation pattern: "translation.key.here[inputs='hello','input 2','input 3']" from a list of strings. Element 1 is used as the key. Subsequent elements (if they exist) are added as inputs.

12086.name: Shape - Pyramid
12086.desc:
Creates a pyramid using a given pattern at a certain location.
You can choose for the pyramid to be hollow, and it can take a size.
By default, the size is 5, and the pyramid will not be hollow.
12086.pattern: create [a] [hollow] pyramid ([made] out of|with|using) [pattern] %string/itemtype/worldeditpattern% [with size %-number%] at %locations% [lazily]

13110.name: Item Frame - is Fixed (Property)
13110.desc:
Gets whether the item frame is "fixed" or not.
Can be set and reset.
When true it's not possible to destroy/move the frame (e. g. by damage, interaction, pistons, or missing supporting blocks), rotate the item or place/remove items.
13110.pattern:
[the] item[ |-]frame [is] fixed [state|property] of %entities%
%entities%'[s] item[ |-]frame [is] fixed [state|property]
whether or not [the] item[ |-]frame %entities% [is] fixed
whether [the] item[ |-]frame %entities% [is] fixed [or not]

3383.name: Translated Chest Name
3383.desc:
Opens a chest with a translatable component name.
 - This currently requires Minecraft version 1.15.1.
 - Backwards compatibility may be added in future versions.
 - Currently, the name may ONLY be your translated key.

6967.name: On Track Event
6967.desc:
Fired when a track receive a specific event. Use the literal to define the event's type such as:
  - START
  - END
  - STUCK
  - PAUSE
  - RESUME
  - SEEK

12087.name: Shape - Sphere
12087.desc:
Creates a sphere using a given pattern at a certain location.
You can choose for the sphere to be hollow, and it can take a set of radii.
By default, the radius is 5, and the sphere will not be hollow.

13623.name: Struct Template
13623.desc:
Creates a struct template. The template name is case insensitive and has the same restrictions as function names.
Fields are defined in the format '[const[ant]] <fieldname>: <fieldtype> [= %object%]'. Their names are case insensitive and consist of letters, underscores, and spaces. No two fields in the same template can have the same name.
The field type can be a single type or a plural type. The default value can be set by adding an optional '= value' at the end of the line.The default value will be evaluated when the struct is created.
Fields can be marked as constant by adding 'const' or 'constant' at the beginning of the line. Constant fields cannot be changed after the struct is created.

6968.name: Member / Bot is in Thread
6968.desc:
Check if a specific member or bot is in a guild thread.
Useful to avoid exception while using join & leave effects.
6968.pattern:
%member/bot% (is|are) in [the] thread %threadchannel%
%member/bot% (isn't|is not|aren't|are not) in [the] thread %threadchannel%

10296.name: Citizen Name
10296.desc: Represents the name of a citizen. Full name is the name of the citizen, non-full is the name without colors.

12088.name: Shape - General
12088.desc:
Creates a shape at a given location. Depending on which shape is being created, a different set of entries can be used.

Entries that can be used with any shape:
* pattern (pattern): the pattern that the shape will be made out of (no default, and this has to be a pattern object (via the pattern expression))
* hollow (boolean): whether the shape will be hollow (default is true)

Entries that can be used with a pyramid:
* size (integer): the size of the pyramid (no default)

Entries that can be used with both a sphere and cylinder:
* radius (number): the radius (on the x-axis) of the shape (no default)
* radiusZ (number): the radius (on the z-axis) of the shape (this is optional, and if not provided, will default to the radius)

Entries that can be used only with a sphere:
* radiusY (number): the radius (on the y-axis) of the shape (this is optional, and if not provided, will default to the radius)

Entries that can be used only with a cylinder:
* height (number): the height of the cylinder (no default)

This section is effectively the same as just using the shape effects, but might be preferable.

13112.name: Projectile - has Left The Shooter (Property)
13112.desc:
Gets whether the provided projectiles have left the hitbox of their shooter and can now hit entities.
This is recalculated each tick if the projectile has a shooter.
Can be set.
13112.pattern:
[the] [projectile] [has] [already] left [the[ir]|its] shooter [state|property] of %projectiles%
%projectiles%'[s] [projectile] [has] [already] left [the[ir]|its] shooter [state|property]
whether or not [the] [projectile] %projectiles% [has] [already] left [the[ir]|its] shooter
whether [the] [projectile] %projectiles% [has] [already] left [the[ir]|its] shooter [or not]

13114.name: Sign - is Editable (Property)
13114.desc:
Returns whether or not the provided signs are editable.
Can be set and reset (which makes it editable).
13114.pattern:
[the] [sign] [is] editable [state|property] of %blocks/blockstates/itemtypes%
%blocks/blockstates/itemtypes%'[s] [sign] [is] editable [state|property]
whether or not [the] [sign] %blocks/blockstates/itemtypes% [is] editable
whether [the] [sign] %blocks/blockstates/itemtypes% [is] editable [or not]

13115.name: Sign - is Waxed (Property)
13115.desc:
Returns whether or not the provided signs are waxed.
Can be set and reset (which makes it not waxed).
13115.pattern:
[the] [sign] [is] waxed [state|property] of %blocks/blockstates/itemtypes%
%blocks/blockstates/itemtypes%'[s] [sign] [is] waxed [state|property]
whether or not [the] [sign] %blocks/blockstates/itemtypes% [is] waxed
whether [the] [sign] %blocks/blockstates/itemtypes% [is] waxed [or not]

6972.name: Message is From Guild
6972.desc:
Check either a message(related event come from a guild or from private messages.
This condition work with every event where a message is sent / received.
6972.pattern:
[the] (message|event) (is coming|come from|is from) guild [channel]
[the] (message|event) (is coming|come from|is from) (dm|(private|direct) message) [channel]

13116.name: Skript - Effect Command String
13116.desc:
The command used in an effect command event.
This doesn't include the prefix (usually `!`).
Can be set, reset and deleted.

13884.name: General - Entity Meta
13884.desc: The entity meta of a minecraft entity (this can both represent a fake entity's meta or a real entity's meta, but is mostly used for fake entities since the only use for real entities is for packet intercepting).

7997.name: Ping's protocol version
7997.desc: The protocol version number in a proxy ping event. For further informations, see https://wiki.vg/Protocol_version_numbers

7998.name: On proxy ping
7998.desc: When the proxy is being ping by a player. Need to inform the proxy that this server is listening to this event with the 'Listen to proxy ping' effect

7999.name: Custom request from other Bungee server
7999.desc: Send a custom request to another Bungee server, and get the response. This can be any value, as long as it could be stored in a variable

6976.name: Is Edited
6976.desc: Return true if the message was edited. Because of discord limitations, we cannot get the editing date.

2625.name: Retrieve Skin
2625.desc: Retrieves a certain skin from online and places it into the specified variable (the object expression at the end). The retrieved skin is either a skin made from the specified image file, a skin from the specified URL, or the skin of either the specified offline player or the offline player with the specified uuid. If you are retrieving a skin made from an image file or from a URL, you can specify it as slim, meaning it would have the smaller arm size like the default Alex skin does, as opposed to the larger arms of the default Steve skin. Note that since this effect has to retrieve data from online APIs, it is a delayed effect and all code following the effect will also be delayed. Tablisknu uses the Mineskin API for retrieving skins based on image files and URLs.
2625.pattern:
retrieve [(slim)] skin from (file|url) %-string% [[with] timeout %-timespan%] into %object%
retrieve skin (from uuid %-string%|of %-offlineplayer%) [[with] timeout %-timespan%] into %object%

6977.name: Is Ephemeral
6977.desc:
Return true if the message was ephemeral, e.g. private / hidden.
Action on hidden messages are limited.

12097.name: Region - Faces
12097.desc:
Gets the faces of a given region. This expression only works on cuboid regions.
This returns another region, which can be used in other operations.

13377.name: Chat Color
13377.desc:
Represents a Chat Color, different from Skript's Color class.
Although not a Citizens type, the only current use is in the Citizen Glow effect.

13889.name: General - On Packet
13889.desc:
Listen to incoming/outgoing packets, more on [the wiki](https://github.com/3add/PacketEventsSK/wiki/Events)
 
**Event Values:**
 - `event-types.packet`
 - `event-player`
13889.version:
1.0.0
1.0.1 altered
1.1.0 (changed from struct to event)
1.1.1 (added packet priority, added listening to all packets and fixed bugs)

2626.name: All Full Color Skins
2626.desc: A list expression for all the full color skins that are available using the Full Color Skin expression. Useful for giving your tabs a bit of color variety without having to specify specific colors.

12354.name: Item - Can Be Enchanted with
12354.desc:
Checks if an item can be enchanted with an Enchantment.
This does not check if the enchantment conflicts with any enchantments already applied on the item.
12354.pattern:
%itemtype% can be enchanted with %enchantment%
%itemtype% can('|no)t be enchanted with %enchantment%

13890.name: Fake Entity - Create Fake Entity
13890.desc:
Create a new fake entity from an entity type.
This creates its own internal event, which means previous event-values will not work.

2627.name: Full Color Skin
2627.desc: An expression for a full color skin, either of the specified color or of one of the explicit color options available.
2627.pattern:
%color% skin
maroon skin
navy skin
olive skin

13891.name: General - Cancel Packet
13891.desc:
Used to cancel the packet in a packet receive/send event.
This just means that the packet won't be processed/sent.

2628.name: Tablist Header or Footer
2628.desc: An expression for the header or footer of the specified or all tablist(s). This is a list expression as the header and footer can have multiple lines of text.

12100.name: Region - Walls
12100.desc:
Gets the walls of a given region. This expression only works on cuboid regions.
This returns another region, which can be used in other operations.

13892.name: General - Fetch Skin
13892.desc:
Used to fetch a player skin.
**This is processed on an async thread and thus will pause your code until it's been loaded.**
13892.pattern:
fetch skin (from|of) player named %string% and store (it|the result) in %-~objects%
set %-~objects% to skin (from|of) player named %string%

6981.name: Profile Has Banner
6981.desc:
Check if the specified profile have a custom banner set or not.
Useful to manage either its banner URL of color accent.

13381.name: Citizens Entity Pose
13381.desc:
Represents the 'pose' of a Citizens NPC.
Essentially different animations, depending on the entity type of the NPC.

13893.name: General - Send/Receive Packet
13893.desc: Used to force the server to send or receive a packet, optionally silently. (silent means it won't trigger on packet send or receive)

6982.name: Execute X Using Bot
6982.desc:
This effect is for utilities purpose.
It will wrap the actual effect from DiSky and execute it using the specified bot.
The syntax MUST come from DiSky, and at least ONE bot MUST be loaded (if the specified one is wrong / not loaded)

13894.name: Simple Skin - Player Displayed Skin
13894.desc:
Set the displayed skin of a player for a set of viewers.
Internally everything is handled by the addon (fully packet based).

12359.name: Player - Can Critical Damage
12359.desc:
Checks if a player is in position to inflict a critical hit.

Read https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Damage#Critical_hit for more info.

13895.name: Simple Glow - Entity Glow State
13895.desc:
Set the glow state of an entity for a set of viewers.
Internally everything is handled by the addon. (fully packet based)

6984.name: Create Emote
6984.desc:
Create a new emote in a specific guild.
The name must be between 2 and 32 chars and the guild should not have an emote with the same name.
The URL will represent the image, and can be either a web URL or a local path.
6984.pattern: (make|create) [the] [new] emote (named|with name) %string% with [the] (url|path) %string% in [the] [guild] %guild% and store (it|the emote) in %object%

10824.name: Particle
10824.desc:
A mirror of SkBee's Particle type. For use when SkBee is not installed.
Represents a particle which can be used as a shape's particle, or in the Draw Particle and Particle Spawn effects.
Some particles require extra data, these are distinguished by their data type within the square brackets.
DustOption, DustTransition and Vibration each have their own functions to build the appropriate data for these particles.

6985.name: Create Thread
6985.desc:
Create a new thread in a text channel with a base name.
The bot used in that effect will automatically join the thread, so you don't have to make it join yourself.
If you create a private thread, then you cannot specify a message.
Else, the Thread will be created based on the specified message.
Creating private thread need the guild to be level 2 or more, else it'll throw an exception.
6985.pattern: (make|create) [the] [new] [private] thread (named|with name) %string% in [the] [channel] %channel/textchannel% [(with|using) [the] [message] [as reference] %message%] [(with|using) [the] [bot] %bot%] and store (it|the thread) in %object%

12105.name: Region - Expand/Contract
12105.desc:
Makes a region larger or smaller in a given direction by a given amount. Optionally takes an opposite amount to expand the region in the other direction.
Regions can also be expanded vertically, which makes them span from the min to the max of the world they're in.

13897.name: Fake Entity - Ride
13897.desc:
Make fake entities ride another entity (fake or real), or remove them as passengers.
**Note: Real entities are just a single packet being sent, when a player relogs, changes worlds or some other circumstances the passengers will be altered by the vanilla server.**

3658.name: Translated Action Bars
3658.desc:
Sends a translated action bar message to players.
 - This message can be a default one from the Minecraft lang file.
 - It can also be a custom one included via mod or resource pack.
 - Inside the language files, you can use ? to colour messages.

6986.name: Defer Interaction
6986.desc:
Only usable in interaction event, currently button click/dropdown update/modal event!
This will force the interaction to be acknowledge, you have 3 seconds to do so, the effect will send a success message to Discord or hold the interaction to send a message later.
Keep in mind that replying in an interaction event will automatically defer the interaction, and therefore you don't need to defer it.
If you need to wait more than 3 seconds use the and wait pattern
An interaction can only be deferred once!

12106.name: Region - Inset/Outset
12106.desc: Insets or outsets a region by a given number of blocks. Can optionally only perform the operation vertically (up and down) or horizontally (north, south, east, and west).

13386.name: Armor - is Dyed
13386.desc:
Checks whether the provided armor items are dyed (they don't have the default color).
This works for leather armor, horse leather armor and wolf armor.

This might not work correctly on Spigot.

12107.name: Region - Block Count
12107.desc: Gets the number of a certain type of block in a region. Can use a mask to specify more than one kind of block.
12107.pattern:
[the] (count|number) of blocks in %worldeditregions% that match [mask] %string/itemtype/worldeditmask%
[the] (count|number) of %string/itemtype/worldeditmask% [blocks] in %worldeditregions%

10828.name: Register new particle effect
10828.desc: Registers a new particle effect, once it is registered you can start or stop it using those expressions. Optionally you can also set the particles it uses however you can do this any time before or after starting the effect.

12108.name: Schematic - Paste
12108.desc: Pastes a schematic at a location(s). Can be rotated, and can choose whether it should ignore air or not.
12108.pattern: paste [schem[atic]] [named|with name] %string% at %locations% [(with rotation|rotated by) %number% [degrees]] [[and] while ignoring air]

12364.name: Should Trigger Advancements
12364.desc:
This Condition requires Paper.

Checks whether or not the Slot Change event should trigger advancements.
12364.pattern:
[the] event will trigger [any] advancements
[the] event w(ill not|on't) trigger [any] advancements

6989.name: Load Members
6989.desc:
Load every members of a guild.
This effect will also cache members that were not, so execution may be delayed.
consider calling this effect once, then use the default member expression to get the members.
6989.pattern: load [all] members (of|from) [the] %guild% and store (them|the members) in %objects%

12109.name: Schematic - Save
12109.desc:
Saves a region as a schematic.
The name of the schematic shouldn't include any path, as skript-worldedit will always start at WorldEdit's schematics directory.
The centre of the schematic can be set, as well as whether or not it should overwrite an existing schematic of the same name.

13901.name: General - Packet Field
13901.desc:
Gets or sets a field's value from a packet by its name.

### Available Packets and their fields
* **destroy entities** allowed fields:
  `entity ids (or: ids)`
* **entity metadata** allowed fields:
  `entity id (or: id) | entity metadata (or: entity meta, metadata, meta)`
* **entity velocity** allowed fields:
  `entity id (or: id) | velocity vector (or: vector, velocity)`
* **select bundle item** allowed fields:
  `slot id (or: id) | selected item index (or: selected index, item index, index)`
* **game test highlight pos** allowed fields:
  `absolute position (or: absolute pos, abs position, abs pos, position, pos) | relative position (or: relative pos, rel position, rel pos)`
* **block change** allowed fields:
  `block position (or: block pos, position, pos) | block state (or: state, block data, data)`
* **open sign editor** allowed fields:
  `block position (or: block pos, position, pos) | sign side (or: side)`
* **block entity data** allowed fields:
  `block position (or: block pos, position, pos) | block entity type (or: entity type, type) | nbt compound (or: nbt, compound)`

6990.name: Move Member
6990.desc:
Move a member to another voice chat.
You can only move a member if they were previously in a voice channel.

10830.name: Start particle effect
10830.desc:
Starts a particle effect of a given id name.
- Using the sync optional makes the effect play in a synchronous runnable instead
- Adding a delay makes the effect start later
- The effect will play only once unless you add the repeating option
- The repeating option will play infinitely unless the number of times option is used
- When using repeat the interval is used to determine how fast between iterations
- The targeting option is only used for certain effects
10830.pattern: (start|run) [sync] particle effect %string% at %objects% [targeting %-objects%] [delayed by %-timespan%] [repeat(ed|ing) [%-number% times] with [an] interval of %-timespan%]

12110.name: Schematic - Paste
12110.desc:
Pastes a schematic, with a bunch of configurable options (see below for a list of them).
Note that the name of the schematic shouldn't include any path, as skript-worldedit will always start at WorldEdit's schematics directory.

Entries:
* paste entities: whether the schematic should copy entities
* paste biomes: whether the schematic should copy biomes
* ignore air: whether the schematic should paste air blocks
* rotation: the number of degrees that the pasted schematic should be rotated by (around the y-axis)
* mask: a mask which will only let matching blocks be pasted

12111.name: Schematic - Save
12111.desc:
Saves a region as a schematic, with a bunch of configurable options (see below for a list of them).
Note that the name of the schematic shouldn't include any path, as skript-worldedit will always start at WorldEdit's schematics directory.

Entries:
* copy entities: whether the schematic should copy entities
* copy biomes: whether the schematic should copy biomes
* remove entities: whether the schematic should remove entities
* overwrite: whether the schematic should overwrite any schematics of the same name (if false, the schematic won't save if a schematic is found with the same name)
* origin: where the origin of the saved schematic should be
* mask: a mask which will only let matching blocks be copied

12367.name: Trident - has Collided
12367.desc: Checks if one or more (thrown) tridents have collided (they must have dealt damage to an entity or have hit the floor).

13391.name: Armor - Color
13391.desc:
Gets the color of the provided armor items.
This works for leather armor, horse leather armor and wolf armor.
Can be set.

13903.name: General - Player Skin of Player
13903.desc:
Gets the skin the player had when they joined the server
NOTE: This only works on servers in online mode

6992.name: Post Message / Upload Files
6992.desc:
Post a specific message as text, embed or message builder to a channel.
You can either join files path to the message, or only upload files with no message content.
Files are parsed from the Minecraft server home, and not your machine's home.
6992.pattern:
(post|dispatch) [the] [message] %string/embedbuilder/messagebuilder% (in|to) [the] [channel] %channel% [with [the] (component|action)[s] [row] %rows%] [with [the] file[s] %strings/images% [with [the] option[s] %attachmentoptions%]] [and store (it|the message) (inside|in) %objects%]
upload [the] [file[s]] %strings/images% [with [the] option[s] %attachmentoptions%] (in|to) [the] [channel] %channel% [with [the] (component|action)[s] [row] %rows%] [and store (it|the message) (inside|in) %objects%]

13392.name: Armor Stand - is Small (Property)
13392.desc: Gets and sets the `small` property of an armorstand entity or item, to do so with an armorstand item you must have Paper.
13392.pattern:
[the] [armor[ |-]stand] [is] small [state|property] of %livingentity/itemtypes%
%livingentity/itemtypes%'[s] [armor[ |-]stand] [is] small [state|property]
whether or not [the] [armor[ |-]stand] %livingentity/itemtypes% [is] small
whether [the] [armor[ |-]stand] %livingentity/itemtypes% [is] small [or not]

13904.name: General - Player Skin From Base64/Signature
13904.desc:
Creates a skin object using a Base64 value and an optional cryptographic signature.
The value contains the texture URL, while the signature proves the skin is authentic from Mojang.

6993.name: Purge Messages
6993.desc:
Discord provide a better way to delete multiple messages at once.
This effect only works with messages, and a list is recommended here.
If you want to delete a single message, use the destroy effect.

13393.name: Block - Liquid Level
13393.desc:
Represents the maximum, minimum or current amount of fluid contained within a block, either by itself or inside a cauldron.
Minimum Level requires Paper and 1.18.2.

This expression includes liquid blocks, cauldron and composters.

For water and lava blocks the levels have special meanings: a level of 0 corresponds to a source block, 1-7 regular fluid heights, and 8-15 to "falling" fluids.
All falling fluids have the same behaviour, but the level corresponds to that of the block above them, equal to this. level - 8

**Note that counterintuitively, an adjusted level of 1 is the highest level, whilst 7 is the lowest.**

May not be higher than the max level.

Can be set, added to, removed from and reset.
Reset requires Paper and 1.18.2.

3410.name: Create a GUI
3410.desc:
It creates a new gui with a given id (optional), using a base inventory, and a shape (optional)
For more info, read the [here](https://github.com/Tuke-Nuke/TuSKe/wiki/GUI-Manager)

6994.name: Reply With / To Message
6994.desc:
Reply with a specific text, embed or message builder.
A reference message can be provided, and therefore the mention optional part can be implemented.
This effect will only work with events that implement 'message event' (aka every channel-related events)
6994.pattern: reply with [hidden] [the] [content] %string/embedbuilder/messagebuilder% [with [the] (component|action)[s] [row] %rows%] [with reference[d] [message] %message% [(mentioning)]] [with [the] file[s] %strings/images% [with [the] option[s] %attachmentoptions%]][and store (it|the message) in %objects%]

13394.name: Block/BlockData/BlockState/Item - Slipperiness
13394.desc:
Returns a value that represents how 'slippery' the block is.
Blocks with higher slipperiness, like ice can be slid on further by the player and other entities.
Most blocks have a default slipperiness of 0.6.

Can be used with items, blocks, blockstates, and blockdatas.

6995.name: Retrieve Messages
6995.desc:
Retrieve last X messages from a specific message channel.
You can retrieve up to 100 last messages, others will be ignored.
Don't forget to use 'purge' effect to delete a lot of messages the most enhanced way ever.
6995.pattern: retrieve [last] %number% [amount of] message[s] (of|in|from) %channel% and store (them|the messages) in %objects%

6996.name: Retrieve Profile
6996.desc:
Retrieve the profile of the specified user.
Profile represent mainly the banner of the user, could return the accent color if non set.
6996.pattern: retrieve profile (with|from) id %string% (from|with|of|in) %user% [(with|using) [the] [bot] %bot%] and store (it|the profile) in %object%

3413.name: Cancel Drops
3413.desc: Cancels the drops of items, experiences or both in death events, where it won't drop the **player** items (like gamerule KeepInventory), or cancel the item drop of break block event (for minecraft 1.12+ only).
3413.pattern:
cancel [the] drops
cancel [the] drops of [e]xp[perience][s]
cancel [the] drops of (inventory|items)

6997.name: Retrieve Threads
6997.desc:
Retrieve every threads (and cache them) from a specific guild.
This effect will only get back the ACTIVE thread, and will pass on the archived ones.
6997.pattern: retrieve [(all|every)] thread[s] (from|with|of|in) %guild% [(with|using) [the] [bot] %bot%] and store (them|the thread[s]) in %objects%

13141.name: Anvil Gui - on Open/Close/Click Section
13141.desc:
Runs the code inside of it when the provided anvil gui is opened, closed or clicked.

Local Variables that are:
- defined BEFORE this section CAN be used inside of it.
- defined AFTER this section CANNOT be used inside of it.
- defined INSIDE this section CANNOT be used outside of it.

13397.name: Entity - Should Burn During The Day (Property)
13397.desc:
Returns whether or not the provided entities should burn during the day.
Applies to zombies, skeletons (all types), and phantoms

In 1.17.1 this doesn't work with skeleton variants, such as strays, but it does work with base skeletons.

Can be set.
13397.pattern:
[the] [[living[ |-]]entity] (should|will) burn ((during|in) [the] day|(in|under) [the] (sun[light]|daylight)) [state|property] of %livingentities%
%livingentities%'[s] [[living[ |-]]entity] (should|will) burn ((during|in) [the] day|(in|under) [the] (sun[light]|daylight)) [state|property]
whether or not [the] [[living[ |-]]entity] %livingentities% (should|will) burn ((during|in) [the] day|(in|under) [the] (sun[light]|daylight))
whether [the] [[living[ |-]]entity] %livingentities% (should|will) burn ((during|in) [the] day|(in|under) [the] (sun[light]|daylight)) [or not]

3414.name: Command with Permission
3414.desc: Make the player execute a command with a temporary permission, when the player finishes executing the command, the permission is removed.
3414.pattern:
[execute] [the] command %strings% by %players% with perm[ission][s] %strings%
[execute] [the] %players% command %strings% with perm[ission][s] %strings%
(let|make) %players% execute [[the] command] %strings% with perm[ission][s] %strings%

6998.name: Send typing
6998.desc:
Sends the typing status to discord. This is what is used to make the message "X is typing..." appear.
Typing status lasts for 10 seconds.

10838.name: Particles - Clientside/visible players of effect
10838.desc: Gets, sets, adds to and removes from the list of players able to see an effect, if the list is deleted all players can see the effect
10838.pattern:
[the] [(clientside|visible)] player[s] of [the] [particle] effect %strings%
[particle] effect %strings%'[s] [(clientside|visible)] player[s]
[(clientside|visible)] player[s] of [the] [particle] effect

13142.name: Entity - on Resurrect Section
13142.desc:
Runs the code inside of it when the provided entity dies and may have the opportunity to be resurrected.
Will be called in a cancelled state if the entity does not have a totem equipped.

Local Variables that are:
- defined BEFORE this section CAN be used inside of it.
- defined AFTER this section CANNOT be used inside of it.
- defined INSIDE this section CANNOT be used outside of it.
13142.pattern:
[execute|run] on [entity] resurrect[ion] [attempt] of %entity%
[execute|run] when %entity% (resurrect[s]|attempt[s] to resurrect)

13398.name: Entity - is Angry (Property)
13398.desc:
Returns the Angry Property of an entity. (Warden, PigZombie, Wolf, Enderman)
Can be set for all except wardens.

To use this for endermen `Paper 1.18.2+` is required.

6999.name: Shutdown Bot
6999.desc:
Stop and disconnect a loaded bot from DiSky & discord.
If any requests was still remaining, they will be executed before the actual bot shutdown
Using the force pattern will cancel all requests and shutdown the bot instantly.

12375.name: Will Raise Composter Level
12375.desc:
This Condition requires Paper.

Checks whether or not the composter's level will rise in a Compost Item Event
12375.pattern:
[the] composter level will be raised
[the] composter level w(ill no|on')t be raised

13143.name: Run Silently
13143.desc:
Executes the effects within this section without making sounds, this currently only supports the changing of an item frame's item.

Note: this is not related to errors or warnings in the console.

13399.name: Entity - is Interested (Property)
13399.desc:
Returns whether or not the provided foxes or wolves are interested.
Paper 1.18.2+ is required to use this with foxes.
13399.pattern:
[the] [[living[ |-]]entity] [is] interested [state|property] of %livingentities%
%livingentities%'[s] [[living[ |-]]entity] [is] interested [state|property]
whether or not [the] [[living[ |-]]entity] %livingentities% [is] interested
whether [the] [[living[ |-]]entity] %livingentities% [is] interested [or not]

13911.name: Fake Entity Property - Elytra Flying State
13911.desc: Represents the fake elytra flying state of a fake entity, this only changes the client side metadata, it doesn't actually make the entity fly

7000.name: TimeOut Member
7000.desc:
Timeout a member (temporal exclusion) for a specific duration and with an optional reason.
You can either timeout UNTIL a specific date (Skript date), or FOR a specific timespan (Skript timespan).
This also can be used to remove the current time out, if the bot has the permission to do so.
7000.pattern:
time[( |-)]out %member% for %timespan% [(for [the reason]|due to) %string%]
time[( |-)]out %member% until %date% [(for [the reason]|due to) %string%]
(stop|remove) time[( |-)]out (from|of) %member%

10840.name: Particles - Location
10840.desc: Similar to the location vector expression this one instead sets the location from either another location or an entity. Adding and removing locations instead of to the location
10840.pattern:
[the] location[s] of [the] [particle] effect %string%
[particle] effect %string%'[s] location[s], location[s] of [the] [particle] effect

12376.name: WorldBorder - Change is Instant
12376.desc:
This Condition requires Paper.

Checks whether or not the worldborder change is instant in the worldborder change event

13400.name: Entity - is Sitting (Property)
13400.desc:
Returns whether an entity is sat. Can be set.
This works for Cats, Wolves, Parrots, Pandas and Foxes.
On Paper 1.20.1+ it applies for some other entities which have a SITTING pose.

13401.name: Sign - is Editable (Property)
13401.desc:
Returns whether or not the provided signs are editable.
Can be set and reset (which makes it editable).
13401.pattern:
[the] [sign] [is] editable [state|property] of %blocks/blockstates/itemtypes%
%blocks/blockstates/itemtypes%'[s] [sign] [is] editable [state|property]
whether or not [the] [sign] %blocks/blockstates/itemtypes% [is] editable
whether [the] [sign] %blocks/blockstates/itemtypes% [is] editable [or not]

8026.name: Creation - Build Advancement Tab
8026.desc:
Builds the last created advancement tab.
This can only be used inside of the advancement tab section.

12378.name: is Placing in Pot
12378.desc:
This Condition requires Paper.

Checks whether or not the item is being placed inside the flower pot in a Flower Pot Manipulate Event.
12378.pattern:
[the] (flower|plant|item) is being (placed|picked up)
[the] (flower|plant|item) is(n't| not) being (placed|picked up)

13402.name: Suspicious Stew - Custom Potion Effects
13402.desc:
Gets the custom potion effects applied to the provided suspicious stew.

Can be: set, added to, removed from, removed all x from, cleared and reset.
Clear and reset do the same thing, same for remove and remove all.
Remove and remove all can take either potion effects or potion effect types.
13402.pattern:
[the] suspicious stew [custom] potion effects of %itemtypes%
%itemtypes%'[s] suspicious stew [custom] potion effects

7003.name: Connect / Disconnect Bot
7003.desc:
Connect or disconnect a bot to a specific audio channel (or disconnect it from the current one).
The bot must have the required permissions to connect to the channel.
If using the disconnect pattern, only the guild will be required.

8027.name: Disable Vanilla Advancement
8027.desc:
Disables all of the vanilla advancements. This can be undone by restarting the server by turning it off and back on, just so no one gets confused.
WARNING: This quite literally disables ALL vanilla advancements, including recipes! It will spam your console with warnings as well.

10843.name: Particles - Color RGB values
10843.desc: Gets the current color of a particle, setting a color with this expression will make it a solid color
10843.pattern:
[the] [%-number%(st|nd|rd|th)] particle (r[ed]|g[reen]|b[lue]) value of [the] [particle] effect %string%
[particle] effect %string%'[s] [%-number%(st|nd|rd|th)] particle (r[ed]|g[reen]|b[lue]) value
[%-number%(st|nd|rd|th)] particle (r[ed]|g[reen]|b[lue]) value of [the] [particle] effect
(r[ed]|g[reen]|b[lue]) value of [the] particle
particle (r[ed]|g[reen]|b[lue]) value

604.name: Redis Player Last Login
604.pattern:
[the] last login of redis[[ ]bungee] [(player|uuid)] %string%
redis[[ ]bungee] [(player|uuid)] %string%'s last login

3164.name: Email expression
3164.desc: If it isn't inside an email scope, this expression returns a new Email. If it is inside of an email scope, it returns the email that belongs to that scope.

7004.name: Load Local Track
7004.desc:
Loads a local track from the files of your server.
The supported file types are:
- MP3
- FLAC
- WAV
- Matroska/WebM (AAC, Opus or Vorbis codecs)
- MP4/M4A (AAC codec)
- OGG streams (Opus, Vorbis and FLAC codecs)
- AAC streams
- Stream playlists (M3U and PLS)
7004.pattern: load local track [from] [the] [file] %string% and store (it|the track) in %-objects%

7005.name: Play Tracks in Guild
7005.desc:
Play a specific **loaded** track (through search or local) in a specific guild.
Even if the bot is not yet connected, it will still start playing and the track will continue.
Don't forget to use the `Connect` effect before!
If the bot was already playing tracks, then the new one will simply be queued.

12381.name: Bell - Ring
12381.desc:
Rings a bell.
The blockface must be cartesian.

**NOTE: Skript has its own version of this effect, difference is in the fact that Skript's uses Directions while Lusk's uses Blockfaces, for that reason I will not deprecate this Effect.**

7006.name: Discord Command Argument
7006.desc: Works same as Skript's command argument. You can specify the argument number or the argument type (in case there's only one user or member for example) to get the selected value.
7006.pattern:
[][the] last arg[ument][s]
[][the] arg[ument][s](-| )<(\d+)>
[][the] <(\d*1)st|(\d*2)nd|(\d*3)rd|(\d*[4-90])th> arg[ument][s]
[][the] arg[ument][s]
[][the] %*classinfo%( |-)arg[ument][( |-)<\d+>]
[][the] arg[ument]( |-)%*classinfo%[( |-)<\d+>]

12382.name: Cancel Composter Level Rise
12382.desc:
This Effect requires Paper.

Can only be used in a Compost Item Event.
Sets whether or not the composter's level should rise.

95.name: Armor Stand Item Boots
95.pattern:
armo[u]r stand boots of %entity%
armo[u]r stand %entity%'s boots

7007.name: Used Alias
7007.desc:
Return the used alias in a discord command trigger section.
It can only be used here, and will throw an error if not.

10847.name: Particles - Offset vector
10847.desc: This property works best when the amount of particles is more than 1, it makes the particle offset randomly between the start location and the offset value
10847.pattern:
[the] [%-number%(st|nd|rd|th)] particle offset vector of [the] [particle] effect %string%
[particle] effect %string%'[s] [%-number%(st|nd|rd|th)] particle offset vector
[%-number%(st|nd|rd|th)] particle offset vector of [the] [particle] effect
offset vector of [the] particle
particle offset vector

96.name: Armor Stand Item Chestplate
96.pattern:
armo[u]r stand chest[ ][plate] of %entity%
armo[u]r stand %entity%'s chest[ ][plate]

7008.name: Used Argument
7008.desc:
Return the plain formatter of the discord command's argument
You should however use (arg-1) for example which will return the argument value directly.
This is intended to be for test purpose only, and therefore only return a String formatted containing every used arguments.

10848.name: Particles - Offset XYZ values
10848.desc: Similar to the other particle offset expression this one lets you change the individual x, y or z values separately
10848.pattern:
[the] [%-number%(st|nd|rd|th)] particle (x|y|z) offset value of [the] [particle] effect %string%
[particle] effect %string%'[s] [%-number%(st|nd|rd|th)] particle (x|y|z) offset value
[%-number%(st|nd|rd|th)] particle (x|y|z) offset value of [the] [particle] effect
(x|y|z) offset value of [the] particle
particle (x|y|z) offset value

98.name: Armor Stand Item Leggings
98.pattern:
armo[u]r stand leg[ging][s] of %entity%
armo[u]r stand %entity%'s leg[ging][s]

3426.name: Evaluate
3426.desc:
This effect will run any Skript effect/condition from a given string or piece of code. The difference between {{effects|EvaluateInputEffect|SkQuery effect}} and this is basically it returns all syntaxes errors instead of send them to the console, It can evaluate a long amount of code and see them easily instead of beeing in one line. 
For example, you can run a effect from a string, from a piece of code (without beeing quoted) or the entiry section of code.
Starting from 1.8, you can disallow some syntaxes when evaluating. Read more about it at config file (`TuSKe/config.yml`).
3426.pattern: eval[uate][ logging [[the] error[s]] in %objects%][ with safety]: (%strings%|<.+?>)

7010.name: Sub-command Groups
7010.desc:
Represent every sub-slash-command groups a slash command have.
You can add sub-slash-commands to a group, then add this group into the base slash command.

13922.name: Fake Block Display Entity - Display Block Data
13922.desc:
Represents the block data of a Block Display Entity.
See [Display Entity Data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Display#Entity_data) on McWiki for more details.

99.name: Add Click Event
99.pattern: add click event with action %clickeventaction% (and|with|to) [(execute|text|link)] %string% to [text component] %textcomponent%

3427.name: All Recipes
3427.desc: Returns all server recipes. You can get the {{expressions|RecipeIngredients|ingredients}} and the {{expressions|RecipeResult|result item}}.

4195.name: Lambda when
4195.desc: Executes the event when the given predicate (condition) is true. If the limiter is set the event is only executed once otherwise it'll be executed every time the condition is met.

7011.name: Group / Command Sub-Commands
7011.desc:
Represent every sub-slash-command a slash-command or a group have.
You can add sub-slash-commands to a group or a core slash-command, then add this group into the base slash command.

13923.name: Fake Item Display Entity - Display Item Type
13923.desc:
Represents the display ItemType of an Item/Block Display Entity
See [Display Entity Data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Display#Entity_data) on McWiki for more details.

7012.name: New Button
7012.desc: Create a new button with an ID and some optional options. It can be either enabled or disabled, and either link or action. If the button is a link-type, then the ID will be the URL that the user will be redirect to.

13924.name: Fake Text Display Entity - Background Color
13924.desc:
Represents the background color of a Text Display Entity.
See [Display Entity Data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Display#Entity_data ) on McWiki for more details.

7013.name: New Components Row
7013.desc:
Create a new (empty) components row.
You can add either max 5 buttons or one dropdown to it.
A single message can hold 5 components rows.

6246.name: Icon of marker
6246.desc:
Returns the icon of a marker/markerbuilder
It can be get, set or reset.
There is a list of all default dynmap icons: https://github.com/webbukkit/dynmap/wiki/Using-markers#marker-icons

7014.name: New Dropdown Option
7014.desc:
Create a new dropdown option with different properties.
The value represent the returned string that this dropdown will return if this option is selected.
The name / label is the actual shown name on the option.
Description and emote are optional.
7014.pattern: [a] new [default] [dropdown] option with value %string% (named|with label) %string% [with description [%string%]] [with [emoji] %emote%]

10854.name: Particles - Effect extra value
10854.desc: Get or set the extra value of an effect if it has this property. To learn more please see the individual particle effects!
10854.pattern:
[the] [%-number%(st|nd|rd|th)] extra [value] of [the] [particle] effect %string%
[particle] effect %string%'[s] [%-number%(st|nd|rd|th)] extra [value]
[%-number%(st|nd|rd|th)] extra [value] of [the] [particle] effect

13926.name: Fake Text Display Entity - Display Text Shadowed
13926.desc:
Represents the shadowed state of a Text Display Entity.
See [Display Entity Data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Display#Entity_data) on McWiki for more details.

10855.name: Particles - Effect radius
10855.desc:
Sets or gets the radius of most effects
Also used for parametric equation effect types as well(can use negative numbers)
10855.pattern:
[the] [%-number%(st|nd|rd|th)] radius of [the] [particle] effect %string%
[particle] effect %string%'[s] [%-number%(st|nd|rd|th)] radius
[%-number%(st|nd|rd|th)] radius of [the] [particle] effect

12391.name: Player - Fake Experience
12391.desc:
Send an experience change. This fakes an experience change packet for a user. This will not actually change the experience points in any way.
Progress must be within 0 and 1.
12391.pattern:
show [fake] [e]xp[erience] level %integer% and progress %number% to %players%
show [fake] [e]xp[erience] level %integer% to %players%
show [fake] [e]xp[erience] progress %number% to %players%

13927.name: Fake Display Entity - Display Billboard
13927.desc:
Represents the billboard of a Display Entity.
See [Display Entity Data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Display#Entity_data) on McWiki for more details.
13927.pattern:
[the] fake display billboard of %entitymeta%
%entitymeta%'[s] fake display billboard

7016.name: Emoji / Emote
7016.desc:
Get an emoji or an emote from its name, ID or unicode.
- An emoji is discord-side only, can be used everywhere, and don't have any attached guild.
- An emote is guild-side only, have a custom long ID and are attached to a guild.
It the specified reaction doesn't exist, DiSky will simply return null and say it in console.
We highly recommend the specification of the guild when retrieving an emote, to avoid conflicts with other that potentially have the same name.

12392.name: Player - Show Credits
12392.desc: Shows a player the win screen that normally is only displayed after one kills the ender dragon and exits the end for the first time.

13928.name: Fake Display Entity - Display Height/Width
13928.desc:
Represents the height/width of a display entity.
See [Display Entity Data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Display#Entity_data) on McWiki for more details.

7017.name: Last DiSky Exception
7017.desc:
Return the last occurred DiSky or Discord exception in the current event.
This expression is event-based, means you cannot get the last error that happened on another event.
Once this has been called, it will remove the returned value from the errors list to avoid having two times the same error message.

10857.name: Particles - Auto yaw
10857.desc: Make certain particle effects turn with the player or turn to face the player(depending on the effect type)
10857.pattern:
[the] auto face of [the] [particle] effect %string%
[particle] effect %string%'[s] auto face, auto face of [the] [particle] effect

13929.name: Fake Display Entity - Display Interpolation Delay
13929.desc:
Represents the interpolation delay of a display entity.
See [Display Entity Data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Display#Entity_data) on McWiki for more details.
13929.pattern:
[the] fake display interpolation delay of %entitymeta%
%entitymeta%'[s] fake display interpolation delay

10858.name: Particles - Effect rotation
10858.desc: Rotates specific effects using a vector, requires auto rotation expression for the effect be set to true
10858.pattern:
[the] rotation vector of [the] [particle] effect %string%
[particle] effect %string%'[s] rotation vector, rotation vector of [the] [particle] effect

13674.name: Size of json object/array
13674.desc:
Returns the size of the json object or array.
If the json is null or primitive, it will return null.
If the json is an object, it will return the number of keys.
If the json is an array, it will return the number of elements.

13930.name: Fake Display Entity - Display Rotation
13930.desc:
Represents the transformation left/right rotation of a Display Entity.
See [Display Entity Data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Display#Entity_data) on McWiki for more details.

7019.name: Discord Members of Guild / Channel
7019.desc:
Returns a list of members.
For Message text-related channel & category, it returns members with permission to view the channel
For Audio Channels it returns the currently connected members of the channel.

10859.name: Particles - Rotation XYZ values
10859.desc:
Rotates specific effects using a specific x, y, z values, requires auto rotation expression for the effect be set to true.
This allows you to set the x, y or z value individually without changing the other values
10859.pattern:
[the] (x|y|z) rotation value of [the] [particle] effect %string%
[particle] effect %string%'[s] (x|y|z) rotation value, (x|y|z) rotation value of [the] [particle] effect

13931.name: Fake Display Entity - Display Scale
13931.desc:
Represents the transformation scale of a Display Entity.
See [Display Entity Data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Display#Entity_data) on McWiki for more details.
13931.pattern:
[the] fake display scale of %entitymeta%
%entitymeta%'[s] fake display scale

7020.name: Guild / Member Roles
7020.desc:
Represent the roles that a guild or a member currently have.
Can be changed, SET and ADD ChangeMode can be used when passing a member.
To modify guild's roles, check delete and create role effects.

10860.name: Particles - Effect solid mode
10860.desc: Some effects particles can either appear solid or moves along its path, such as the circle or other simple effects.
10860.pattern:
[the] solid mode of [the] [particle] effect %string%
[particle] effect %string%'[s] solid mode, solid mode of [the] [particle] effect

13932.name: Fake Display Entity - Teleport Interpolation Duration
13932.desc:
Represents the teleport interpolation duration of a Display Entity.
See [Display Entity Data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Display#Entity_data) on McWiki for more details.
13932.pattern:
[the] fake display teleport interpolation duration of %entitymeta%
%entitymeta%'[s] fake display teleport interpolation duration

13165.name: Bell - Ring
13165.desc:
Rings a bell.
The blockface must be cartesian.

**NOTE: Skript has its own version of this effect, difference is in the fact that Skript's uses Directions while Lusk's uses Blockfaces, for that reason I will not deprecate this Effect.**

13933.name: Fake Display Entity - Transform Interpolation Duration
13933.desc:
Represents the transform interpolation duration of a Display Entity.
See [Display Entity Data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Display#Entity_data) on McWiki for more details.
13933.pattern:
[the] fake display transform interpolation duration of %entitymeta%
%entitymeta%'[s] fake display transform interpolation duration

1390.name: Bungeecord player online
1390.desc: Check if a player is online the Bungeecord. Keep in mind that they need to have joined the proxy and not through a port for it to work.
1390.pattern:
bungee[[ ]cord] [(player|uuid)] %string/player% (1?is|2?is(n't| not)) online [the] [bungee[[ ]cord]]
[(player|uuid)] %string/player% (1?is|2?is(n't| not)) online [the] bungee[[ ]cord]

13166.name: Bell - Resonating Time/Ticks
13166.desc:
Returns the time or ticks since one or more bells have been resonating, or 0 seconds for each bell that's not currently resonating.
A bell will typically resonate for 40 ticks (2 seconds)

Note: if you wish to use this expression on Skript 2.9+ you will need to use Lusk 1.3+.

13934.name: Fake Display Entity - Translation
13934.desc:
Represents the translation of a Display Entity.
See [Display Entity Data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Display#Entity_data) on McWiki for more details.
13934.pattern:
[the] fake display translation of %entitymeta%
%entitymeta%'[s] fake display translation

13167.name: Bell - Shaking Time/Ticks
13167.desc:
Returns the time or ticks since one or more bells have been shaking, or 0 seconds for each bell that's not currently resonating.
A bell will typically resonate for 50 ticks (2.5 seconds)

Note: if you wish to use this expression on Skript 2.9+ you will need to use Lusk 1.3+.

13935.name: Fake Display Entity - View Range
13935.desc:
Represents the view range of a Display Entity.
See [Display Entity Data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Display#Entity_data) on McWiki for more details.
13935.pattern:
[the] fake display view[ ]range of %entitymeta%
%entitymeta%'[s] fake display view[ ]range

1393.name: Bungeecord chat/command
1393.desc: Execute a bungeecord command or chat on a player. Keep in mind that the command is executed on the current Spigot server of the user. There is another syntax to execute on the Bungeecord. Doesn't support colour. If you want colour, I suggest using the evaluate effect.

13169.name: Brewing - Remaining Time/Ticks
13169.desc: Returns the brewing time of a Brewing Stand (the time before the brewing is over, 0 seconds = finished, 20 seconds = just started. Can be set to a longer time, progress won't be displayed until it reaches 20 seconds).\nCan be set.

11891.name: Twitch Add Blocked Term
11891.desc:
Adds a word or phrase to the broadcaster???s list of blocked terms. These are the terms that broadcasters don???t want used in their chat room.

The term must contain a minimum of 2 characters and may contain up to a maximum of 500 characters.

Terms can use a wildcard character (*). The wildcard character must appear at the beginning or end of a word, or set of characters. For example, *foo or foo*.
The bot needs to be at least Moderator!!!

12403.name: Block - Blast Resistance
12403.desc:
Obtains the blast resistance value (also known as block "durability").
This value is used in explosions to calculate whether a block should be broken or not.

Only works for placeable item/blocks.

7028.name: Message Embeds
7028.desc: Get every embeds of a specific messages. Keep in mind only webhook are allowed to send more than one embed!

11892.name: Twitch Add Channel Moderator
11892.desc:
Adds a moderator to the broadcaster???s chat room.
The bot needs broadcaster permission!!! (So only selfbots work here!)

12404.name: Block - Slipperiness
12404.desc:
Returns a value that represents how 'slippery' the block is. Blocks with higher slipperiness, like ice can be slid on further by the player and other entities.
Most blocks have a default slipperiness of 0.6.

Only works for placeable item/blocks.

11893.name: Twitch Add Channel VIP
11893.desc:
Adds a VIP to the broadcaster???s chat room.
The bot needs broadcaster permission!!! (So only selfbots work here!)

12405.name: BlockFace - Between Blocks
12405.desc:
Returns the face relation of a block compared to another block.

If the blocks are not connected nothing will be returned.

7030.name: Message Emotes
7030.desc:
Get every mentioned emotes in a message.
This will only return custom emote, and will therefore not include discord emotes.

13174.name: Bounding Box - Overlaps
13174.desc: Whether or not one or more bounding boxes overlap other bounding boxes.\nBounding boxes that are only intersecting at the borders are not considered overlapping.

11895.name: Twitch Remove Blocked Term
11895.desc:
Removes a word or phrase from the broadcaster???s list of blocked terms. These are the terms that broadcasters don???t want used in their chat room.

The term must contain a minimum of 2 characters and may contain up to a maximum of 500 characters.

Terms can use a wildcard character (*). The wildcard character must appear at the beginning or end of a word, or set of characters. For example, *foo or foo*.
The bot needs to be at least Moderator!!!

13175.name: Bounding Box - X is Within
13175.desc:
Whether or not a Vector, Location, or Bounding Box is within a Bounding Box.

Vector and Location = Checks if the Bounding Box contains a specified position.
Bounding Box = Checks if the Bounding Box fully contains a Bounding Box.

13687.name: Cached storage watcher - un/bind from file
13687.desc: Binds or unbinds a storage watcher to a file. This is used to watch for changes in the file and update the cache accordingly.
13687.pattern:
[skjson] bind storage watcher to %string%
[skjson] unbind storage watcher from %string%

2680.name: Entity Having Potion Effect
2680.desc:
Checks if living entity has applied given potion effect(s). 
If one of this effects will exist on entity, return will be "true".
2680.pattern:
[morkazsk] [the] %livingentity% (has|is having) potion effect %potioneffecttypes%
[morkazsk] [the] %livingentity% (hasn(t|'t)|is((nt|n't)| not) having) potion effect %potioneffecttypes%

7032.name: Message Mentioned Roles
7032.desc: Get every mentioned Roles in a message. If the message doesn't come from a guild it will return an empty array!

11896.name: Twitch Remove Channel Moderator
11896.desc:
Removes a moderator from the broadcaster???s chat room.
The bot needs broadcaster permission!!! (So only selfbots work here!)

13688.name: Create JSON file with/out content
13688.desc:
Creates a JSON file with the given name and content. If the file already exists, it will be replaced if the configuration is set to replace=true.
If the content is not provided, an empty JSON object will be created.
The configuration can be used to set the encoding and other options.
13688.pattern:
[skjson] new json file %string%
[skjson] new json file %string% with [content] %objects%
[skjson] create json file %string% [with configuration<\[\s*((\w+)=([\w-]+)(?:,\s*)?)+\s*\]>]
[skjson] create json file %string% and write to it %object% [with configuration<\[\s*((\w+)=([\w-]+)(?:,\s*)?)+\s*\]>]

2681.name: Naturally Break Block
2681.desc:
This effect will naturally break given block.
It is possible to define specific tool which block will be broken (in this situation drop can be modified by this tool).

7033.name: Message Reactions
7033.desc:
Get every reactions of a message.
Because of Discord's limitation, we cannot get which user reacted with which reaction, you'll have to count them yourself.

11897.name: Remove Channel Vip
11897.desc:
Removes a VIP from the broadcaster???s chat room.
The bot needs broadcaster permission!!! (So only selfbots work here!)

13689.name: Send created/prepared request
13689.desc:
Sends a previously created HTTP request to the specified URL
The request must be created using request creation commands (e.g. 'create request').
Supports both synchronous and asynchronous sending using the 'non' or 'not' tag.

7034.name: User Badges
7034.desc:
Represent every badges' name a user have.
This does not and cannot contain any intro-related badges (nitro membership or nitro boosting), it need OAuth2 to be enabled.

11898.name: Set Emote Only Mode
11898.desc:
Set the emote only mode of the chat to the specified value.
Emote only mode is a feature on Twitch that allows you to limit what user can send messages in a chat. When emote only mode is enabled, only emotes can be sent in the chat.
This effect requires the broadcaster/moderator permission to set emote only mode.
A Boolean value that determines whether chat messages must contain only emotes.

12410.name: Bounding Box - of Entity/Block
12410.desc: Returns the bounding box of a block or an entity which reflects its location and size. (But not its world, kind of like vectors)

11899.name: Set Follower Only Mode
11899.desc:
Set the follower only mode of the chat to the specified value.
Follower only mode is a feature on Twitch that allows you to limit how often each user can send messages in a chat. When follower only mode is enabled, only followers of the channel can send messages.
This effect requires the broadcaster/moderator permission to set follower only mode.

13691.name: Virtual json storage
13691.desc: Creates a virtual json storage. This is used to create a virtual json storage that can be used to store data in memory.

1404.name: Bungeecord shutdown server
1404.desc: Shutdown a bungeecord server. The saving section of the syntax will allow server instance users to save the files of the server. If not they get deleted.

7036.name: New Message Command

11900.name: Set SlowMode
11900.desc:
Set the slowmode of the chat to the specified value.
Slowmode is a feature on Twitch that allows you to limit how often each user can send messages in a chat. When slow mode is enabled, users can only send one message every x seconds.
This effect requires the broadcaster/moderator permission to set slowmode.
If you don't specify a delay, the default delay is 5 seconds. The value has to be in a range of 3 to 120 seconds.

7037.name: New Option Choice
7037.desc:
Create a new slash command option choice with an unique name and a string or number value.
Choices are only available for STRING, NUMBER and INTEGER slash command option type.
Of course, the provided value type must be compatible with the option type (you cannot add string choice to a NUMBER option).

11901.name: Set Subscribers Only Mode
11901.desc:
Set the subscribers only mode of the chat to the specified value.
Subscribers only mode is a feature on Twitch that allows you to limit how often each user can send messages in a chat. When subscribers only mode is enabled, only subscribers of the channel can send messages.
This effect requires the broadcaster/moderator permission to set subscribers only mode.

13693.name: Count keys/values in the json
13693.desc: Counts the number of keys or values in the json. This is used to count the number of keys or values in the json.

2686.name: Spawn Particle at Location
2686.desc:
This effect will spawn specified particle with given options. It will be spawned for everyone
If chunk will be not loaded, it will not spawn particle, so it is safe and it will not affect your TPS that much like normal spawning may do.
Use bukkit "Particle" enum names as particle name. You can use dots and name do not have to be upper cased.
List of names is here: https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/Particle.html
2686.pattern:
[morkazsk] (summon|play|create|activate|spawn) %number% [of] [particle] %string%:%number% offset (at|by|from) %number%, %number%(,| and) %number% at %location%
[morkazsk] (summon|play|create|activate|spawn) %number% [of] [particle] %string% offset (at|by|from) %number%, %number%(,| and) %number% with extra [data] %number% at %location%

7038.name: New User Command

11902.name: Set Unique Chat Mode
11902.desc:
Set the unique chat mode of the chat to the specified value.
A Boolean value that determines whether the broadcaster requires users to post only unique messages in the chat room.
When unique chat mode is enabled, only unique users can send messages in the chat.
This effect requires the broadcaster/moderator permission to set unique chat mode.

13182.name: Entity - on Right Click Section
13182.desc:
Runs the code inside of it when the provided entity gets clicked.

Local Variables that are:
- defined BEFORE this section CAN be used inside of it.
- defined AFTER this section CANNOT be used inside of it.
- defined INSIDE this section CANNOT be used outside of it.

7295.name: Create Mongo collection
7295.desc: Quickly create a collection with a specific name in one of your databases. Make sure it does not exist first.

7807.name: Disguise - Item Stack
7807.desc:
Set or get the item of a disguise.
For Dropped Item Disguises, it returns the item of it.
For Item Frame Disguises, it returns the item inside the frame.
For throwable projectiles (eggs, snowballs, enderpearls, etc.), it returns the displayed item.
Other disguises don't have items associated with them.

12415.name: Brewing - Time
12415.desc:
Returns the brewing time of a Brewing Stand (the time before the brewing is over, 0 seconds = finished, 20 seconds = just started. Can be set to a longer time, progress won't be displayed until it reaches 20 seconds).
Can be set.

13183.name: Entity - on Damage Section
13183.desc:
Runs the code inside of it when the provided entity takes damage.

Local Variables that are:
- defined BEFORE this section CAN be used inside of it.
- defined AFTER this section CANNOT be used inside of it.
- defined INSIDE this section CANNOT be used outside of it.
13183.pattern:
[execute|run] on damage of %~entity%
[execute|run] when %~entity% (get[s] damaged|take[s] damage)

7040.name: Target Message
7040.desc:
Represent the target message in a message command event.
It basically represent the message that was clicked on.

7296.name: Manage Mongo document
7296.desc: Firstly, you can insert your Mongo document in the collection you want, with an automatically generated unique identifier if not specified or already existing. This will not replace existing documents with the same identifier, but will insert a new one. Secondly, if you want to replace the document, you can use the replace syntax. Finally, to remove the document, simply use remove. This effect is only a shortcut and simply executes a query with "_id" as the unique identifier. If you have changed the unique ID field, you should not use this effect.

385.name: Map Draw Cursor
385.pattern: draw [map] cursor %string% pointing %number% at [coordinate[s]] [x] %number%(,| and) [y] %number% on [skellett] map %map%

7041.name: Slash Command Argument
7041.desc:
Represents a slash command argument.
The name is the ID used when defining the slash command.
Specify the type, so that Skript can parse it correctly. (if it's a number, operation wil be allowed for example)
The type should be the same used when defining the argument in the command.

13697.name: Get all keys from Json object
13697.desc: Returns all keys from the given json object. If the path is provided, it will return all keys from the object at that path.

13698.name: Get cached json storage
13698.desc: Get cached json storage. This is used to get the cached json storage. If the id is not provided, it will return all json storages.
13698.pattern:
[skjson] json storage of id %string%
[skjson] all json storages

387.name: Map Draw Text
387.pattern: draw text %string% at [coordinate[s]] [x] %number%(,| and) [y] %number% on [skellett] map %map%

7043.name: Target User
7043.desc:
Represent the target user in a user command event.
It basically represent the user that was clicked on.

7299.name: Mongo Embedded Value
7299.desc: It is sometimes redundant to extract a document from a document from a document etc... and undertake several data manipulations on several lines. To remedy this, this expression will only ask you the path (MongoSK specific syntax, be careful) as follows: "foo.bar", or "foo[0].bar" or "foo.bar[2]" for example. Embedded documents must be separated by a dot, and you must specify in brackets the index of the array (starting from 0) if it is a list.

2692.name: Fishing Caught Entity
2692.desc: Caught entity (hooked by fishing rod) in fishing event. It may be also fish drop item in specific fishing state.

7044.name: Get Bot / Bot Named X
7044.desc:
Get a cached bot from DiSky using its unique name.
If the desired bot does not exist or is not loaded yet, this expression will return none.
This expression cannot be changed.

7300.name: Mongo collection
7300.desc: Retrieve a specific collection via its name from a database on your Mongo server. You must specify the database where your collection is located.

13700.name: Json values
13700.desc:
Returns the value of the json at the given path. If the path is not provided, it will return all values from the json.
If the path is a number, it will return the value at that index in the array.
If the path is a string, it will return the value at that key in the object.
If the path is empty, it will return all values from the json.

7045.name: Get Category
7045.desc:
Get a category from a guild using its unique ID.
Categories are global on discord, means different categories cannot have the same ID.
This expression cannot be changed.

7301.name: Mongo collection document count
7301.desc: If you want to know the number of documents in a collection, you should use this expression. Please note that this is an estimate.
7301.pattern:
[the] mongo[(db|sk)] estimated doc[ument][s] count of %mongoskcollections%
%mongoskcollections%'[s] mongo[(db|sk)] estimated doc[ument][s] count

11909.name: Blocked Terms
11909.desc:
Gets the broadcaster???s list of non-private, blocked words or phrases. These are the terms that the broadcaster or moderator added manually, or that were denied by AutoMod.
The bot needs to be at least Moderator!!!

13189.name: Creeper/Primed TNT/TNT Minecart - Max/Regular Fuse Time/Ticks

13701.name: New json element
13701.desc:
Creates a new json element from any object, file or website.
This is used to create a new json element from any object, file or website.
13701.pattern:
[skjson] json from file %strings%
[skjson] json from website %strings%
[skjson] json (from|of) %objects%

7046.name: Get Thread Channel
7046.desc:
Get a thread channel from a guild using its unique ID.
Threads are global on discord, means different threads cannot have the same ID.
This expression cannot be changed.

7302.name: Mongo command result
7302.desc: This expression is very useful and gives complete freedom to use your database with MongoSK. Indeed, it allows to execute any command to a database, which will return the documents to you. You are therefore no longer dependent on the features of MongoSK, and you can use any commands. To learn more about the possible commands, see: https://docs.mongodb.com/manual/reference/command/.

13702.name: Prepare Web requests
13702.desc:
allowed methods are [GET, POST, PUT, HEAD, MOCK, DELETE, PATCH]
allowed value type of content is Json or stringify json (Json as String) e.g. "{""Test"": true}"
allowed value type of header is Json or (Pairs e.g. "Content-Type: application/Json", "Allow: restrict")

You can execute the request by 'send prepared {_request}', otherwise the request will be not sent, but the request will be still stored
And you can get response status/content/headers like in the examples

7047.name: Get Voice Channel
7047.desc:
Get a voice channel from a guild using its unique ID.
Channels are global on discord, means different channels cannot have the same ID.
This expression cannot be changed.

7303.name: Mongo database
7303.desc: Retrieve a specific database from a Mongo server. You must specify in which Mongo server your collection is located.

13191.name: WorldBorder - Change is Instant
13191.desc: This Condition requires Paper.\n\nChecks whether or not the worldborder change is instant in the worldborder change event

2696.name: Last Login Date of Offline Player
2696.desc:
Returns date of last login of offline player. 
If offline player never logged, it will be <none>.

7048.name: Get Member
7048.desc:
Get a cached member from its unique ID
This expression could return null, according to if the actual member was cached or not.
To be sure it will return the corresponding member, use the retrieve member effect.
This expression cannot be changed

7304.name: Mongo database name of a collection
7304.desc: Retrieves the name of the database to which the collection belongs. You can then use the expression to retrieve a database by its name if you wish.
7304.pattern:
[the] mongo[(sk|db)] database name of %mongoskcollections%
%mongoskcollections%'[s] mongo[(sk|db)] database name

7049.name: User in Guild
7049.desc:
Get the member related to the specified user in a specific guild.
Users are common to whole Discord, two user cannot have the same instance.
Members are common to guilds, but also holding an user as reference.
User can have multiple instance according to which guild they are in, therefore they are considered as member.

7305.name: Mongo distinct query
7305.desc: The distinct query is useful when you want to retrieve a specific field from each document in a given collection. For example, if you have documents with a "name" field, you can use this expression to retrieve all the "name" fields of the documents in the collection.
